verdict.rationale: Insomnia offers several sandbox paths. Users can stand up mock servers (cloud, self-hosted Mockbin, or Liquid-templated dynamic mocks with fake data), and AI can generate these mocks from a prompt, OpenAPI spec, or live URL. Environments (global, collection, folder) let users swap base URLs and credentials so requests can target non-production endpoints. Missing for 10: no documented guardrails that block requests from hitting production, no explicit sandbox or production-isolation docs, and no independent or hands-on corroboration.
